recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量細胞質充滿粗大橘紅色嗜伊紅顆粒的細胞，包括成熟雙葉嗜伊紅球與圓核的嗜伊紅性骨髓細胞，部分顆粒帶紫藍色調（未成熟顆粒），顯示嗜伊紅球系明顯增生。
features: Markedly increased eosinophil lineage cells across all stages of maturation
Eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes with round to indented nuclei and cytoplasm packed with coarse orange-pink granules
Some precursors contain admixed dark purple-blue (immature, basophilic-staining) granules
Mature bilobed and segmented eosinophils present
Scattered neutrophilic precursors, small lymphocytes and a few erythroid cells; no increase in blasts apparent in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked eosinophilic hyperplasia, with eosinophils at all stages of maturation including myelocytes, metamyelocytes and mature segmented forms containing coarse orange-pink granules. Some immature eosinophilic precursors contain admixed purple-blue granules. Neutrophilic precursors, lymphocytes and erythroid cells are present in reduced proportion, and blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow eosinophilia; evaluation for reactive causes and for myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms with eosinophilia (PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, JAK2 rearrangements) and CEL is recommended.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; distinguished clinically and by absence of clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities.
May show increased atypical mast cells and eosinophils with FIP1L1::PDGFRA detected by FISH or RT-PCR.
Shows increased myeloblasts/monoblasts with abnormal eosinophils bearing large purple-violet basophilic granules.
Shows granulocytic hyperplasia with basophilia and eosinophilia plus BCR::ABL1.
